name: bosona
archetype: Directional maker on crypto Up/Down windows (two-wallet cluster with almach)
headline: Rests bids on the side of BTC (and some ETH/SOL) Up/Down windows that it expects to win, and gets filled by takers below fair value. The profit is real, persistent and barely depends on rebates. But no public-data quoting rule matches its fills, and every public-data maker version, including an optimistic one, loses 14-26% in the same windows.
mechanism: 94% of sampled fills are maker fills (on-chain, 95% CI 90-97%). It trades 5m (55%), 15m (28%), hourly and 4h windows, buys both sides in only 45% of markets and earns on the directional residual (+$68.8k, residual win rate 58%). Shares it buys at 0.35 win 41% of the time, at 0.14 win 19%. It shares 6,524 transactions and two-thirds of its markets with almach; 25% of their (market, second) pairs coincide.

match.detail: spot-model directional maker: held-out AUC 0.502 (perm p=0.30) on BTC 5m, 0.464 (p=0.75) on BTC 15m; spot-latency taker: AUC 0.48 (p=0.44); fixed-level bids: not its pattern and lose 45-81%

backtest.detail: public-data maker on held-out windows: -25.6% (5m), -23.9% (15m), -14% to -18% even with optimistic at-touch fills; bosona's own maker fills there +3.5% (5m, p=0.20), +9.7% (15m, p=0.30)

replicable.detail: a slow maker is adversely selected in these markets at every latency tested (0-10 s); the wallet's edge appears to come from queue priority and fast cancels

persistence.detail: last 30 days significant (p=4e-4), no decline (p=0.40); only 18% taker rebate, at 0% tier still ~$86k/month

reasons: No public-data rule reproduces which passive fills it gets (held-out AUC at chance on 5m and 15m).
Every public-data maker version loses significantly in the same windows, even assuming first-in-queue fills.
Its own fills profit modestly where a slow imitator loses, which points to speed and queue position the replicator would not have.
